name: pulsecord
description: PulseCord 4.0 - App estilo Discord com Sincronização Ultra-Rápida, YouTube Player, Parsec 60-120fps + Controle Xbox Virtual, Áudio no Chat, Fixação e Mensagens Privadas P2P em LAN
author: PulseCord

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:electron: concurrently -n CLIENT,ELECTRON -c magenta,green "npm run dev:client" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && cross-env PULSECORD_DEV=1 electron ."
scripts.build:client: npm --prefix client run build && node scripts/release-signing.mjs sign-ui
scripts.build: npm run build:icon && npm run build:native && npm run build:client
scripts.build:exe: npm run build && electron-builder --win portable && node scripts/release-signing.mjs sign-exe
scripts.build:installer: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis && node scripts/release-signing.mjs sign-exe
scripts.build:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis portable && node scripts/release-signing.mjs sign-exe
scripts.build:signed: npm run build && node scripts/build-signed.mjs && node scripts/release-signing.mjs sign-exe
